pages.title: Automatic Producer
pages.text: Put flies in the input slot and the barrel continuously produces the resource tied to that fly type.

pages.title: Stacking Speed
pages.text: The base production interval is about 42.5 seconds. Each extra fly of the same type in the input slot shortens the interval by 0.5 seconds, down to 1 second minimum.$(br2)Insert flies from the top and sides, and extract products from the bottom.

pages.title: Product Examples
pages.text: Normal flies produce maggot seeds, red flies produce redstone, iron flies produce raw iron, diamond flies produce diamonds, dragon fruit flies produce gunpowder, and ender flies produce ender pearls.$(br2)Check JEI for the full product list.
